source: OpenWeatherMap One Call API 3.0 timemachine, one answer per hour (data[0] of each), as received

_promo.substitution: pop (One Call's chance of rain, which timemachine records lack) set to Open-Meteo Historical Forecast ecmwf_ifs025 precipitation_probability / 100 by 3-hour ensemble block (fill-ecmwf-chance.json): the record stamped dt (the hour starting at dt) takes the bucket at the first 3-hour UTC boundary at or after dt + 1 h, as openmeteo.js ensembleBlockSlice reads the slot starting at dt; uvi, where a record has none, set to Open-Meteo GFS uv_index stamped dt + 1 h (fill-gfs-uv.json), as openmeteo.js mapUv reads the hour starting at dt; wind_gust, where a record has none, set to Open-Meteo best_match windgusts_10m stamped dt + 1 h (fill-gust.json, the app's own gust request: the max of the hour starting at dt, as openmeteo.js mapGusts reads it) / 1.60934, km/h to the history's mph
